rca_of_issue: n/a — This iteration only verifies the fix. Original RCA per problem statement: outer 90s wait_for killed _generate_month before 4 concurrent 7-day chunks could complete; one slow LLM chunk starved siblings. Fix: (a) per-chunk 75s cap so one slow chunk cannot hang the whole gather; (b) outer 90s → 180s on both roster worker + retry worker; (c) frontend SLOW/STUCK banners moved from 60s/120s to 90s/210s to match new realistic thresholds; (d) partial persistence loop already in place at server.py:2440+ and 2668+, so users still get workouts for the weeks that DID succeed.
